answer.content: [p. 2] ARP is a protocol that translates IP addresses to MAC addresses, allowing hosts to communicate directly. [p. 2] Example: A host sends an ARP request to find the MAC address for an IP address, and the device with that IP responds with its MAC address. [p. 2]
